capsuleEnvelope.reentryPoint: Review target gaps, agree on focal dimensions, then open the Strategy Canvas twin.
capsuleEnvelope.compressionDisclosure: This projection carries selected expectation and opportunity state. Current-state evidence, focalization differences, and defensibility details remain available as explicit gaps or source references.

modules.summary: The next responsible system makes accessibility, extensibility, modularity, security, and evidence traceability visible enough for collaborators to agree on a good-enough threshold.
Research, operations, engineering, accessibility, and governance participants may weight the dimensions differently.
Raise accessibility and evidence traceability, create clearer extension seams, reduce coupled workflows, and preserve security as a continuous constraint.
Current-state scores and counter-signals remain target-local until source-supported observations are attached.
Security, publication boundaries, accessibility verification, and migration cost remain active constraints.
Which dimensions should remain separate, and who may set the good-enough threshold?

strategyDimensions.label: Accessibility
strategyDimensions.definition: Participants can perceive, operate, understand, and recover the intended collaboration routes under the locally reviewed conditions.

anchors.low: Access depends on exceptional help or an undisclosed workaround.
anchors.middle: Primary routes are usable with known gaps and review points.
anchors.high: Primary and recovery routes are operable, understandable, and verified with relevant participants.

strategyDimensions.evidenceBasis: Attach participant, keyboard, touch, assistive-technology, zoom, and recovery receipts before consequential review.

strategyDimensions.label: Extensibility
strategyDimensions.definition: A bounded local variation can enter through a documented contract while the shared behavior remains coherent.

anchors.low: A local change requires broad coupled edits.
anchors.middle: Known variants use selected extension points.
anchors.high: Documented seams support local variation with parity, ownership, and recovery checks.

strategyDimensions.evidenceBasis: Trace one representative extension from local need through implementation, verification, and upgrade.

strategyDimensions.label: Modularity
strategyDimensions.definition: Responsibilities and state transitions have boundaries that collaborators can understand, change, and verify independently.

anchors.low: Responsibilities and state changes are broadly entangled.
anchors.middle: Primary responsibilities have named modules with some shared-state coupling.
anchors.high: Boundaries, inputs, outputs, ownership, and verification contracts are explicit.

strategyDimensions.evidenceBasis: Follow a change across source, state, rendering, export, and consumer boundaries.

strategyDimensions.label: Security
strategyDimensions.definition: Data, authority, imports, exports, and embedded operations follow an explicit least-capability collaboration contract.

anchors.low: Trust and authority boundaries remain implicit.
anchors.middle: Principal data and embed boundaries are declared with known open conditions.
anchors.high: Input, storage, export, embed, identity, authorization, and recovery paths are verified together.

strategyDimensions.evidenceBasis: Review import safety, literal-text handling, local persistence, iframe permissions, export scope, and service boundaries.

strategyDimensions.label: Evidence traceability
strategyDimensions.definition: A consequential reading carries a visible route to its source, transformation, standing, limits, and reviewer.

anchors.low: Basis depends on recollection or unlinked material.
anchors.middle: Principal readings link to partial evidence and named open conditions.
anchors.high: Source, transformation, evidence standing, counter-signals, and review history remain inspectable.

strategyDimensions.evidenceBasis: Sample material readings and recover each claim, source, interpretation, and review state.

strategyCanvasAdapter.reviewCondition: Confirm dimension meaning, anchors, evidence standing, and decision horizon before opening a human-first sealed round.
